national.name: Germany
national.short: EU dates. BEG funds only natural refrigerants from 1 Jan 2028; the 5-point efficiency bonus ended 21 Jul 2026.
national.subsidy: BEG/KfW 458: natural refrigerants only from 1 Jan 2028 (R290, R744 …). The 5-point efficiency bonus ended on 21 Jul 2026.
national.installer: R32 units remain fundable until 31 Dec 2027. A 15-point bonus for EU-made units is planned from 2027.

national.name: United Kingdom
national.short: No 2027 heat-pump ban. Own F-gas rules; Northern Ireland follows the EU dates.
national.law: No 2027 ban. Only single splits under 3 kg with GWP above 750 (since 2025); air-to-water splits exempt. Northern Ireland follows the EU.
national.subsidy: Boiler Upgrade Scheme: no refrigerant condition.
national.installer: R32 monoblocs stay on sale in Great Britain after 2026.

national.name: France
national.short: EU dates. No refrigerant criterion in the CEE heat-pump sheet; HFC tax repealed in 2025.
national.law: EU dates apply. Extra charge limits for flammable refrigerants in public buildings (ERP, since Sep 2025).
national.subsidy: CEE (BAR-TH-171): no refrigerant criterion — the bonus hinges on the ADEME agrément.
national.installer: No HFC tax since 2025. Check ERP rules before an R290 or R32 job in a public building.

national.name: Poland
national.short: EU dates. Czyste Powietrze has no refrigerant criterion; Lista ZUM entry counts.
national.law: EU dates apply. National F-gas act amended in Jan 2026 (operator register, fines).
national.subsidy: Czyste Powietrze: no refrigerant criterion. The model must be on the Lista ZUM on the invoice date.
national.installer: Sell F-gas equipment with a certified installer on the contract.

national.name: Italy
national.short: EU dates. Conto Termico 3.0: no GWP rule for air/water; easier ηs threshold only for low-GWP air/air.
national.law: EU dates apply. National F-gas register and sanctions decrees are being updated.
national.subsidy: Conto Termico 3.0: no GWP condition for air/water. Air/air ≤ 12 kW gets a lower ηs threshold if GWP is under 150.
national.installer: Model must be in the GSE catalogue; keep F-gas Banca Dati records.

callout.text: of residential models in HeatPump DB use a refrigerant with GWP 150 or more. From 1 January 2027 none of them may be newly placed on the EU market as a monobloc or as a split up to 12 kW — the stock already in the channel can still be sold.

foot1: ¹ Single split systems under 3 kg, GWP ≥ 750: banned since 1 Jan 2025. Every date carries a safety exemption; for monoblocs the fallback limit is GWP 750. Cooling-first chillers follow a separate rule. GWP per Regulation (EU) 2024/573 (AR4). Stock: Art. 11(1), 13(19). Models: HeatPump DB European reference catalogue, Oct 2026.
foot2: ¹ Single split systems under 3 kg, GWP ≥ 750: banned since 1 Jan 2025. Every date carries a safety exemption; for monoblocs the fallback limit is GWP 750. Cooling-first chillers follow a separate rule. GWP per Regulation (EU) 2024/573 (AR4). Stock: Art. 11(1), 13(19). Models: HeatPump DB European reference catalogue, Oct 2026.
foot3: Sources: Regulation (EU) 2024/573; BAnz AT 27.08.2026 B1 (BEG EM); gov.uk F-gas bans (27 Aug 2026); SI 2022/565; CEE BAR-TH-171 vA82-5; Czyste Powietrze annex 2 (20 Jul 2026); DM 7 Aug 2025 (Conto Termico 3.0). Checked 23 Oct 2026 — subsidy rules change often; check on the day of the quote.
